title: Letters I Never Sent
subtitle: A Novel
author: Walusimbi Leon (SGSS)
description: Naomi Chen, a magazine editor in New York, finds a box of 47 unsent love letters in a Greenwich Village bookshop and is drawn into the mystery of their writer, Kenji Tanaka.
style: Elegant, literary third-person prose. Atmospheric New York autumn, bookish warmth, emotional depth.
characters: Naomi Chen — 32, Japanese-American magazine editor; the mystery of Kenji Tanaka's unsent letters.
setting: New York (Greenwich Village, The Strand of Memory bookshop).
notes: Early chapters — Naomi just found the box. Develop the discovery of the letters, her growing fascination, and the mystery that unfolds.
